clusters.headline: South Korean Democratic Party Seeks Impeachment Of Chief Justice
aiSummaryBullets: The Democratic Party aims to initiate an impeachment motion against the Supreme Court chief justice on December 3.
The planned action follows the Supreme Court's decision to order a retrial for former Prime Minister Han regarding his martial law role.

clusters.headline: (URGENT) BOK raises key rate to 3.25 pct to curb inflationary pressure
aiSummaryBullets: Yonhap reports: (URGENT) BOK raises key rate to 3.25 pct to curb inflationary pressure
The Korea Herald reports: BOK revises up S. Korea's 2026 growth outlook to 3.9%, 4.1% for 2027

clusters.headline: Seoul Shares Decline Six Percent Amid Lingering AI Market Doubts
aiSummaryBullets: The Korea Composite Stock Price Index dropped over six percent during Wednesday's trading session.
The decline followed an overnight sell-off of technology stocks on Wall Street that triggered global investor concern.

Yonhap reports: Unionized rail workers launch work-to-rule campaign; service disruptions likely

clusters.headline: South Korea Imposes Stricter Penalties Following AI Exam Scandal
aiSummaryBullets: Prime Minister Han Seong-sook ordered a comprehensive investigation into reports of cheating on state-administered examinations.
Proposed measures include distributing 8,000 metal detectors and implementing 10-year bans for students caught using AI-assisted technology.

clusters.headline: Persib Bandung Prepares for AFC Champions League 2 Match vs FC Seoul
aiSummaryBullets: FC Seoul head coach Kim Gi-dong expressed anticipation regarding the atmosphere at Gelora Bandung Lautan Api stadium during the match.
Media reports suggest striker Mariano Peralta may appear in the lineup for the upcoming AFC Champions League 2 fixture.

clusters.headline: President Lee Jae Myung Addresses Domestic Policy and North Korea
aiSummaryBullets: President Lee Jae Myung urged a rapid increase in public housing supply to stabilize the local market.
The administration confirmed that North Korea will remain classified as an enemy in the upcoming defense white paper.

clusters.headline: Finance Minister Lee Hyoung-il Addresses Volatile South Korea Market
aiSummaryBullets: Finance Minister Lee Hyoung-il stated that the government has prepared contingency measures beyond existing stock market stabilization funds.
The KOSPI index experienced a five percent decline, prompting government intervention to address market instability.

clusters.headline: Nvidia Maintains GPU Supply Commitments To South Korea Post-Huang
aiSummaryBullets: Nvidia has maintained its commitment to supply South Korea with graphics processing units.
The assurance follows the resignation of Nvidia Chief Executive Officer Jensen Huang.

NDTV reports: South Korea Says Suspected North Korean Aircraft Breached Island's Airspace

clusters.headline: President Lee Jae Myung Expands Scope Of South Korea Cheonghae Unit
aiSummaryBullets: President Lee Jae Myung announced an expanded operational mandate for the Cheonghae naval unit to ensure maritime safety.
The National Assembly's defense committee approved a motion to shift the unit from Somali waters toward the Arabian region.

clusters.headline: South Korean Fair Trade Watchdog Fines 15 Firms For Bond Collusion
aiSummaryBullets: Fifteen bond dealers have been penalized 1.6 trillion won for colluding on government bond bidding processes.
The decision was issued by the South Korean Fair Trade Commission following an investigation into market rigging practices.

clusters.headline: Hanwha Chair Kim Seung-youn Emphasizes Food Safety At Ourhome Site
aiSummaryBullets: Hanwha Group Chair Kim Seung-youn conducted his inaugural visit to the food service company Ourhome.
The chairman stressed that maintaining food safety standards is more critical than creating unique flavors.

clusters.headline: Samsung Display Acquires 9.1 Percent Stake In Austrian Firm Ams Osram
aiSummaryBullets: Samsung Display is acquiring 9.1 percent of ams Osram for 210 million euros.
The purchase of nearly 10 million newly issued shares makes Samsung the firm's largest shareholder.

clusters.headline: First Lady Kim Hea Kyung Promotes Global Recognition For Kimchi
aiSummaryBullets: First lady Kim Hea Kyung attended a ceremony and event in Seoul to mark the seventh annual Kimchi Day.
During the fair, the first lady viewed exhibits of award-winning cabbage and radish varieties used for the traditional side dish.

clusters.headline: Samsung And SK Hynix Shares Plummet Amid Global Tech Market Slump
aiSummaryBullets: Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix shares recorded significant losses during Friday trading on the Korea Exchange.
The decline follows a broader Wall Street technology sell-off and investor apprehension regarding the sustainability of the AI market.

clusters.headline: Ateez Reaches Fourth Billboard 200 Top Spot With New Album Release
aiSummaryBullets: The K-pop group Ateez achieved their fourth No. 1 on the Billboard 200 chart with their latest release.
The group's 15th EP, titled Golden Hour: Part. 6, reached the top position shortly after their previous release.
